sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Detailed Processes (L1–L4) provide comprehensive documentation of workflows and activities across multiple levels—from high-level process categories (L1) to detailed task sequences (L4). Each level defines inputs, outputs, roles, and supporting systems. By adhering to the ACE model and 6D methodology, it ensures process design is standardized, traceable, and ready for implementation.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Delivers clarity and precision in operational design, reducing ambiguity and improving execution consistency. It enables efficient onboarding, supports automation, and provides a baseline for performance measurement and continuous optimization.
